messages.author: dnlfr1994.gmail.com
messages.body:
Hi everyone,
I would like to ask if there is any working forcefield modification for
terminal 5’ phosphate nucleotides in RNA systems which is compatible with
the current OL3 forcefield.
I’ve looked for some info and I have only found an old (2003) issue in the
Amberlist Archive ( <
http://ambermd.org/Questions/mail/251.html
>
http://ambermd.org/Questions/mail/251.html
) with an example for a guanine
with a terminal phosphate. I am wondering if using the parameters of this
example for a 5’p terminal uracyl would be suitable or not (although, I am
guessing it is not adequate).
I have also found other forcefield and prepi files in GitHub (
<
https://github.com/juvion/AmberFF_tRNA
>
https://github.com/juvion/AmberFF_tRNA
) which seem to be incompatible with
said forcefield.
I would be glad to hear any other suggestions if anyone knows a method to
successfully add a phosphate to a 5’ terminal ribonucleotide and perform the
MD simulation.
Thank you very much in advance,
Daniel Fern�ndez

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Jul 09, 2020, dnlfr1994.gmail.com wrote:
>
>I would like to ask if there is any working forcefield modification for
>terminal 5' phosphate nucleotides in RNA systems which is compatible with
>the current OL3 forcefield.
Yes: look at $AMBERHOME/dat/leap/lib/terminal_monophosphate.lib.  You would
typically use loadOff in tleap to load this (after sourcing leaprc.RNA.OL3).
Somehow, this information didn't make it into the Amber 2020 Reference Manual:
I'll get that fixed.  Note that this library assumes that the terminal
phosphate is singly-protonated.  That is not always the right choice, but we
don't have pre-built residues for other protonation options.
...good luck...dac
